In [[Four-dimensional space|four-dimensional]] [[Euclidean geometry]], the '''bitruncated 24-cell honeycomb''' is a uniform space-filling [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycomb]]. It can be seen as a [[bitruncation]] of the regular [[24-cell honeycomb]], constructed by [[truncated tesseract]] and [[bitruncated 24-cell]] cells. 

== Alternate names==
* Bitruncated icositetrachoric tetracomb/honeycomb
* Small tetracontaoctachoric tetracomb (baticot)
